summary: Users logged out after password reset
description: After resetting their password, users are sent back to login and their session expires immediately.
comment: Root cause: password reset rotated the session signing key for all sessions. Now we only revoke the user's own sessions. Fixed in auth-service 2.14.

summary: Session expires after 5 minutes on mobile app
description: Mobile users report being logged out every few minutes. Refresh token is not being sent from the app.
comment: The iOS app dropped the refresh token cookie when backgrounded. Switched to secure storage for the refresh token.

summary: Google SSO login fails with redirect_uri_mismatch
description: Customers using Google sign in see redirect_uri_mismatch after we moved to the new domain.
comment: Added the new domain callback URL to the Google OAuth client. Keep both URLs until the old domain is retired.

summary: Okta SSO users cannot log in after certificate rotation
description: SAML assertion validation fails for Okta tenants since the IdP rotated its signing certificate.
comment: We cached the IdP certificate forever. Now metadata is refreshed every 6 hours and on validation failure.

summary: Two factor codes rejected for users in UTC+3
description: TOTP codes are rejected for some users in East Africa. Server clock drift suspected.
comment: One API node had 90 seconds of clock drift. Enabled chrony on all nodes and widened the TOTP window to 1 step.

summary: Customers charged twice when clicking pay quickly
description: Double clicking the pay button creates two Stripe charges for the same order.
comment: Added an idempotency key per order to the Stripe charge call and disabled the button after the first click.

summary: Duplicate payment after network retry at checkout
description: When the checkout request times out the client retries and the customer is billed twice.
comment: Same fix pattern as the double click bug: idempotency key derived from the order id, so retries return the first charge.

summary: Prices shown in USD for Kenyan shoppers
description: Shoppers in Kenya see USD instead of KES on product and checkout pages.
comment: GeoIP lookup failed for Safaricom ranges, falling back to USD. Updated the GeoIP database and added a currency picker.

summary: Refunds stuck in pending for M-Pesa payments
description: Refunds for orders paid with M-Pesa never leave the pending state.
comment: The M-Pesa reversal callback URL pointed at staging. Fixed the config and replayed 41 stuck refunds.

summary: Partial refund refunds the full order amount
description: Support issued a partial refund for one item but the customer received the full order total.
comment: Refund amount was taken from order.total instead of the line items. Added a test for partial refunds.

summary: DHL shipping labels fail to generate for addresses with apartment numbers
description: Label creation returns a 400 from DHL when address line 2 is longer than 35 characters.
comment: DHL limits address lines to 35 characters. We now split long address lines across line 2 and line 3.

summary: UPS label PDF is blank when printing
description: Warehouse staff get an empty PDF when printing UPS labels from the order page.
comment: UPS returns ZPL for some accounts. We now request PDF explicitly and convert ZPL when needed.

summary: Shipping rates wrong for heavy parcels over 30kg
description: Checkout quotes the 30kg rate for parcels above 30kg, so we undercharge freight.
comment: Rate table lookup capped weight at the highest bracket. Parcels over 30kg now use the carrier freight API.

summary: Carrier surcharges missing from invoice reconciliation
description: Fuel and residential surcharges from FedEx invoices are not matched to orders, so margins look wrong.
comment: Invoice parser ignored surcharge lines with a different charge code. Mapped all FedEx surcharge codes and backfilled 3 months.

summary: Tracking page shows delivered before the parcel arrives
description: Customers see Delivered while the parcel is still at the local depot.
comment: We mapped the carrier status OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to delivered. Fixed the status mapping table.

summary: Order confirmation emails going to spam for Gmail users
description: Gmail puts order confirmation emails in spam since last week.
comment: DKIM signing broke after the DNS migration. Restored the DKIM record and set up DMARC reporting.

summary: Password reset email never arrives
description: Users request a password reset but no email is delivered. Nothing in the bounce log.
comment: The reset template referenced a deleted partial so rendering threw and the job was dropped silently. Template fixed and job failures now alert.

summary: SMS delivery notifications not sent to Tanzanian numbers
description: Customers with +255 numbers do not receive SMS delivery updates.
comment: Phone normalization stripped the leading zero incorrectly for +255 numbers. Switched to libphonenumber.

summary: Push notifications duplicated on Android
description: Android users receive every order update push notification twice.
comment: Both the legacy and new FCM tokens were registered. We now delete the old token on app upgrade.

summary: Search returns no results for product names with accents
description: Searching for creme does not find Crème brûlée products.
comment: Added ASCII folding to the search analyzer and reindexed the catalog.

summary: Out of stock products ranked first in search
description: Search results show unavailable products above in stock ones.
comment: Added an availability boost to the ranking function. In stock items now get a 2x boost.

summary: Search page takes 8 seconds to load during sales
description: During flash sales the search page is extremely slow and sometimes times out.
comment: Facet counts were computed on every request. Cached facet counts for 60 seconds and added a read replica.

summary: Orders page slow for merchants with many orders
description: Merchants with over 50k orders wait 20 seconds for the orders list.
comment: Missing composite index on (merchant_id, created_at). Added the index and switched to keyset pagination.

summary: Database CPU at 100 percent every night at 2am
description: Nightly the primary database CPU spikes and API requests time out.
comment: The nightly report job ran a full table scan on orders. Moved it to the replica and added the missing index.

summary: CSV export of orders cuts off at 10000 rows
description: Merchants exporting orders only get the first 10000 rows.
comment: Export used a single page query with a hard limit. Now streams the export in batches as a background job and emails a link.

summary: Excel shows broken characters in exported CSV
description: Names with non English characters look garbled when the CSV is opened in Excel.
comment: Excel needs a UTF-8 BOM. Added the BOM to CSV exports.

summary: Duplicate
description: Duplicate of the double charge issue.
comment: Closed as duplicate.

summary: FedEx labels missing the reference number field
description: Labels printed for FedEx do not include our order reference, so returns cannot be matched.

summary: Web users logged out when switching tabs
description: Some users report being logged out of the web app when they switch browser tabs for a few minutes.
